title: Derived affine tensor mate before homology
statement: Let R,A,B,D be commutative rings, with R-algebra structures on A and B and an (A tensor_R B)-algebra structure on D. Assume sheaf derived categories and module derived categories over R and B. Let M be an unbounded A-K-flat complex with quasi-coherent tilde-derived image K=Q(tilde M), and let m be any BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B M D [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. Let phi:A→D and psi:B→D be the restrictions of the coefficient map, and assume the induced spectrum square commutes. Assume the fixed derived phi-pullback counit on tilde M is invertible. Put X=m.derived(Qh(res_R M)), and let T^D be the exact associated-sheaf functor on derived categories over B. Form the actual raw arrow r:T^D X→Rf'_* Q(tilde(D tensor_A M)) by applying T^D to m.counit, the exact-tilde localization comparison, Q of tilde of the complex arrow m.ordinaryIso followed by res_j m.ordinaryToLocalized, the inverse identity-on-carriers scalar comparison and equality transport to phi, then Q of the termwise affine pushforward comparison and the right-derived pushforward unit. There exists sigma:T^D X≅Lg*Rf_*K with sigma.hom followed by the pinned base-change mate [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] equal to r followed by Rf'_* of the identity pullback representative [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-representative-iso]. The source comparison can be constructed independently of D. No homological degree, chosen cohomology coordinate, cartesian hypothesis or coefficient invertibility is used.

proof.text: Apply the affine source comparison, whose isomorphism includes the actual affine right-derived pushforward unit. Its universal equation is the source counit normalization transported through pinned derived-unit compatibility, for every commutative affine square.

Prove the coefficient map formula on pure tensors from ordinaryIso_tmul and ordinaryToLocalized_tmul. Apply ordinary exchange with this formula and compose its equality with the derived counit prefix. The proved factorization API for the raw arrow identifies the right side. Cancel direct image of the invertible pullback counit to obtain the unchanged target equation.

theorem exists_affineTildeDerivedTensorMate
    (φ : A →+* D) (ψ : B →+* D)
    (hφ : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)) = φ)
    (hψ : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) D).comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = ψ)
    (hw : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)) =
      Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ) ≫
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
    (hM : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} A) (.up ℤ)).kFlat M)
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty (Spec (.of A))
      (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)))
    (hc : IsIso ((SingleComplexBaseChange.counit (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ))).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) :
    let K := DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      (((affineTildeFunctor A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let t := affineBaseChangeTildeRepresentativeIso A D φ K M (Iso.refl K) hc
    ∃ σ : (affineExactTildeDerived.{u, w, wM} B).obj
          (m.derived.obj (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ _).obj
            (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (algebraMap R A)).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).obj M)))) ≅
        (derivedPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))).obj
          ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))).obj K),
      σ.hom ≫ schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R B)))
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ)) hw K =
      affineTildeDerivedTensorToPushforward R A B D M m φ ψ hφ hψ ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ψ))).map t.hom
